copyright_boundary: The full transcripts are not reproduced in-repository. This receipt preserves only source metadata and bounded factual event evidence extracted from the user-supplied transcripts.

facts.fact: Greg Johnson gave the opening welcome as pastor of the church hosting the gathering.
Greg Johnson announced Wesley Hill as the guest preacher for the church's Sunday worship service.
facts.modeling_note: This is a church-service announcement, not itself a Revoice conference-session edge.

facts.fact: Chris Gillum was introduced as conference chaplain and as one of Revoice's founding board members, then opened Revoice 18 in prayer.
The conference's three nightly themes were Praise, Lament, and Hope, in that order.
Amber Carroll gave the first-night testimony on Praise.
facts.name_note: The recovered 2019 first-party media title prints 'Amber Carol'; the user-supplied transcript clearly renders 'Amber Carroll'. Preserve the media title verbatim but use Carroll only as a separately resolved name.

facts.fact: Eve Tushnet was introduced as the principal speaker for the first night and spoke on Praise.
A Spiritual Friendship preconference had taken place earlier that day.
facts.modeling_note: Related event, not automatically part of the main conference program.

facts.fact: Organizers said they were recording as much conference content as possible and asked attendees not to make their own voice or video recordings of workshop content.
facts.modeling_note: Useful provenance for why some workshop recordings may survive while others do not.

facts.fact: The schedule included substantial afternoon free time.
The recording explicitly identifies itself as the second evening of Revoice 18.
Ray Low gave the Lament testimony before the principal message.
facts.name_note: The user-supplied transcript renders the surname as 'Lowe', but contemporaneous reporting, current Revoice material, and the person's current ministry biography consistently identify him as Ray Low. The recovered first-party media title prints only 'Ray'.

facts.fact: Nate Collins gave the principal Lament message following the testimony and corporate lament sequence.
facts.basis_note: The transcript does not audibly introduce the post-liturgy speaker by full name in the text supplied, but the recovered first-party media title names Nate Collins and contemporaneous citations attribute the matching message language to him.

facts.fact: Multiple workshops and workshop presenters had already been active that day before General Session 2.
A printed program or program-like packet existed; the speaker directs attendees to a care-team phone number on its last page.
facts.modeling_note: This is direct evidence that a distributed program artifact existed even though the original web program page has not been recovered.

facts.fact: The recovered first-party media page identifies General Session 3 as Hope, with Wesley Hill and a testimony participant printed only as Bekah.

Separate later sources identify the testimony participant as Bekah Mason, but a primary Session 3 transcript or equivalent first-party identity evidence is still preferred before normalizing that full-name resolution.

program_recovery_implication: The General Session 2 transcript establishes that attendees possessed a printed program or program-like packet. Recovery efforts should therefore target photographs, scans, PDFs, attendee archives, and social-media images of the physical packet in addition to the lost revoice.us event page.
graph_rule: This receipt does not infer anonymous attendee identities, endorsement, or workshop participation. Only expressly named event roles may be candidates for later normalized edges.
